stem:
The table shows the time in seconds it took four swimmers to complete a race.

Race Times

| Swimmer          | One  | Two  | Three | Four  |
|------------------|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| Time (seconds)   | 26.15 | 26.5  | 26.1  | 26.05 |

Which inequality correctly compares two of these race times?
visual_elements: Race Times table showing times for four swimmers: One - 26.15, Two - 26.5, Three - 26.1, Four - 26.05
